page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_9_v3 is a dedicated, memory-optimized instance belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family, provisioned under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The physical architecture leverages Intel x86_64 processors to deliver 416 dedicated virtual CPUs. Memory resources total 8,568 GB, yielding an allocation ratio of 20.6 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is designed for scenarios requiring extreme single-system memory density without GPU acceleration.

Local storage is provided via a 429 GB SSD, intended primarily for temporary swap space, scratch workspace, or operating system caching rather than primary persistent data storage. The host is Premium Storage capable, enabling attachment to high-throughput remote storage services to fulfill enterprise persistence requirements. Network provisioning includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard Azure virtual networking infrastructure for ingress and egress routing.

At 416 dedicated cores and over 8.5 terabytes of RAM, this configuration occupies the highest enterprise tier of resource allocation. The design provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for architectures that would otherwise require complex multi-node distributed clustering to fit enormous datasets into memory. By consolidating workloads into a single system image, operational overhead and distributed network serialization penalties are avoided. However, the relatively small local disk capacity requires thoughtful integration with external persistent volumes.

Workload fit centers around massive memory-resident workloads that demand extensive thread concurrency and ultra-large working sets. Primary use cases include enterprise in-memory relational and transactional databases, SAP HANA deployments, massive-scale analytics processing engines, and large in-memory key-value caches.
description: Microsoft Azure M416ds_9_v3 is an ultra-high-capacity memory-optimized virtual machine from the MDSHighMemoryv3 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The server features 416 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor alongside 8,568 GB of system memory, providing approximately 20.6 GB of RAM per core. For transient and caching needs, the configuration includes 429 GB of local SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. It operates without discrete GPUs and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the massive memory footprint and dedicated compute allocation, the instance sits in an upper hardware cost tier, delivering concentrated resource density that eliminates multi-node coordination overhead for memory-bound systems. However, users must account for network or remote disk configurations to persist critical application data beyond the small local SSD. The M416ds_9_v3 is suited for massive in-memory databases, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, extreme real-time analytics, and heavy enterprise data caching workloads.
